evidence.quote: Over the past seven months, I have implemented a comprehensive approach to pragmatic supervision and regulation.
We have proposed re-calibrating the community bank leverage ratio (CBLR) to the statutory minimum to provide greater flexibility to eligible community banks.
A simple solution would be to adjust thresholds by nominal GDP, which includes both economic growth and inflation.
